registry_title: Counterfactual Perturbation and Matched Control Registry
governing_policy: For each targeted construct perturbation, define a matched neutral control perturbation modifying an equivalent number of events without disrupting the target construct.

targeted_perturbation.name: Cadential Resolution Pitch / Harmony Disruption
targeted_perturbation.description: Replaces the final tonic/resolution chord of an authentic or half cadence with an open dissonant harmony or unresolved deceptive pitch (e.g. V7 -> bVI or unresolved tritone).
targeted_perturbation.implementation: Substitute tonic pitch/root at cadential arrival with foreign non-tonic pitch.

matched_control_perturbation.name: Matched Mid-Phrase Neutral Voice Inversion
matched_control_perturbation.description: Swaps pitches of two inner voices at a mid-phrase non-cadential bar without altering harmonic function or phrase boundary.
matched_control_perturbation.affected_events_count: 1 to 4 notes (identical count to target perturbation)
matched_control_perturbation.implementation: Exchange octave/voice positions of identical pitch classes in inner voices.

directional_contrast_statistic.directional_requirement: Mean ClosureContrast across pieces > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.

targeted_perturbation.name: Thematic / Recurrence Cue Incipit Deletion
targeted_perturbation.description: Replaces the initial 2 to 4 bars of a recurrent thematic statement or recapitulation arrival with generic neutral accompaniment texture.
targeted_perturbation.implementation: Zero out primary melodic voice in recurrence window, substituting background diatonic accompaniment.

matched_control_perturbation.name: Matched Neutral Accompaniment Texture Variation
matched_control_perturbation.description: Alters accompaniment figuration pattern 4 bars after the cue arrival, preserving the thematic incipit and harmonic progression.
matched_control_perturbation.affected_events_count: 4 to 16 notes (identical count to target perturbation)
matched_control_perturbation.implementation: Apply block-to-arpeggio variation to accompaniment Staff 2 while leaving thematic Staff 1 intact.

directional_contrast_statistic.directional_requirement: Mean MemoryContrast across pieces > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.

targeted_perturbation.name: Controlled Out-of-Key Chromatic Pitch Injection
targeted_perturbation.description: Injects foreign non-diatonic chromatic pitches (tritone or minor second displacements) into an established diatonic harmonic context.
targeted_perturbation.implementation: Shift selected notes by +/-1 or +/-6 semitones outside current local key scale.

matched_control_perturbation.name: Matched In-Key Diatonic Octave Shift
matched_control_perturbation.description: Shifts an identical number of notes by exactly +1 or -1 octave, preserving diatonic key membership and chord identity.
matched_control_perturbation.affected_events_count: 2 to 6 notes (identical count to target perturbation)
matched_control_perturbation.implementation: Shift note pitch by +/-12 semitones strictly within same spelled pitch class.

directional_contrast_statistic.directional_requirement: Mean SurpriseContrast across pieces > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.
